raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "stay in"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a studio apartment in Manastur"
  role time "2 years"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "provide a guarantee"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "2000 lei"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "at the beginning"

@s3 stated
  relation "have a contract for"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "12 months"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "extend"
  role subject "the contract"
  role object "once"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "make a handover report"
  role subject "the user"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted
  valid on "when moving out"

@s6 stated
  relation "retain the guarantee"
  role subject "the landlord"
  role object "all the money"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "be damaged"
  role subject "the floor"
  role object "scratched"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "when the user arrived"

@s8 stated
  relation "be damaged"
  role subject "the refrigerator"
  role object "making noise"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "when the user arrived"

@q query
  where match
    relation "be allowed to retain the guarantee without a handover report"
    role subject "the landlord"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be allowed to retain all the money"
    role subject "the landlord"
    role object "the guarantee"
    polarity affirmed
  end
